verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack addresses whether LM Studio's downloaded model files (e.g., GGUF/MLX weights) or its local cache can be directly reused by other runtimes without re-downloading or re-converting; the docs only describe LM Studio's own download/search/run features. A community comment even suggests users switch to a single tool (Ollama) to manage all downloads, implying no clear cross-tool reuse story, but this is not a concrete confirmation or denial of file interoperability.
